Unit 10: The HL Case Study

Case Study | 4 Weeks

Unit overview

Can you solve a problem that doesn't exist yet?

This unit covers 3 IB Computer Science sub-topics: PAPER 1, INTERNAL ASSESSMENT, and HL.

The focus areas are Section B (HL Extension), Research Skills, and Strategic Evaluation.

Coverage

  • PAPER 1 Section B (HL Extension)
  • INTERNAL ASSESSMENT Research Skills
  • HL Strategic Evaluation

Objectives and outcomes

Code What You Will Learn What You Should Be Able To Do
PAPER 1 Section B (HL Extension) Apply section b (hl extension) confidently in class and exam-style tasks.
INTERNAL ASSESSMENT Research Skills Apply research skills confidently in class and exam-style tasks.
HL Strategic Evaluation Apply strategic evaluation confidently in class and exam-style tasks.
